name: keypin
description: Key syncs and rotation for the vault you already use. keypin runs your apps with keys from your vault, publishes them to your CI and hosting, and rotates them.

scripts.check: vp check && ! git grep --untracked -nE '(oxlint|eslint)-(disable|enable)' -- '*.ts' && sh scripts/check-lockfile.sh && sh scripts/check-typescript-only.sh && bun scripts/check-action-pins.ts && bun scripts/check-connectors.ts && bun scripts/check-provider-literals.ts && bun scripts/check-file-size.ts && bun scripts/check-docs-growth.ts
